primary_gt.interpretation: All four tests pass, so the computed consequence is a dry, wind-supported tan brightening signal rather than a rainfall or wet-surface signal.

decision_rule.summary: Classify the event image pair by thresholded tan brightening plus a dry-wind index.
decision_rule.score_rule: One point for each passed threshold; score 4 gives the dust-veil classification.

criteria.name: Answer form
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with the requested numeric fields, classification, and one short interpretation.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the numeric answer is recoverable but field names or nesting differ.

criteria.name: Pixel formulas
criteria.description: Uses mean luminance, tan-pixel fraction, and mean red-minus-blue excess exactly as defined.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for using two of the three formulas correctly.

criteria.name: Image deltas
criteria.description: Reports the event-minus-pre values within tolerance: luminance +31.226, tan fraction +0.0245, and red excess +2.4108.
criteria.partial_credit: Award about 1.5 points per correct delta, with small rounding tolerance.

criteria.name: Dry-wind calculation
criteria.description: Computes package point precipitation as 0.0 mm, maximum package point wind as 11.639 m/s, and dry-wind index as 11.639 while treating point weather as a dry-wind comparator.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct dry or wind components with an error in the combined index.

criteria.name: Threshold score
criteria.description: Applies all four threshold tests and returns dust_veil_score = 4 with the dry_wind_tan_brightening_dust_veil classification.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point per correctly evaluated threshold test.

criteria.name: Computed consequence
criteria.description: Rejects a rainfall or wet-surface reading from the near-zero precipitation and avoids treating the image metric as calibrated dust concentration.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for either the wet-surface rejection or the calibration caution.

provenance.notes: All numeric anchors are recomputed from local CSX-300 image and weather data.

supporting_metrics.point_weather_scope: package point-weather values are used only as dry-wind comparators, not as complete corridor wind evidence
